evals.prompt: 帮我快速生成一张图：一只可爱的柴犬坐在樱花树下
evals.expected_output: Picks nano-banana-2-lite for speed. If first generation in session, runs `--preflight --no-gen` first. Runs genius.py with `--model nano-banana-2-lite` (or relies on default), `--poll-only` recommended, reports path under genius_output/, task_id, media_urls, duration, credits.

evals.prompt: 生成一张设计感很强的品牌主视觉：极简留白、强层级、电影级构图的咖啡机海报
evals.expected_output: Picks gpt-image-2 for complex/high-design content. Runs with `--model gpt-image-2` and appropriate aspect/resolution, reports file path and GENIUS_RESULT fields.

evals.prompt: 生成前先检查一下环境，不要真的生图
evals.expected_output: Runs genius.py by absolute path with `--preflight --no-gen` from the current session workspace and reports key/workdir/tunnel pass/fail without creating a generation task.

evals.prompt: 用两个默认模型对比同一张图：赛博朋克夜景
evals.expected_output: Generates batch with nano-banana-2-lite and gpt-image-2 only, runs --batch --concurrent 2, reports both file paths plus task_ids/media_urls, deletes batch config after.

evals.prompt: 用4个模型跑一下同一张图对比效果，prompt是"赛博朋克夜景"
evals.expected_output: Generates genius_output/Tmp/batch_<timestamp>.json with all 4 models, runs --batch --concurrent 4, reports all 4 paths, deletes batch config after.

evals.prompt: 查一下我现在还有多少积分
evals.expected_output: Runs genius.py by absolute path with `--balance` from the current workspace and reports the credit count.

evals.prompt: 测试一下这个 skill 能不能用
evals.expected_output: Runs the lightweight `scripts/test.py` by absolute path only because the user explicitly asked to test the skill, then reports pass/fail.

evals.prompt: 用 premium 模型生成一张 2K 高质量的咖啡机产品图
evals.expected_output: Only when user explicitly asks for premium: runs with `--model gpt-image-2-premium --resolution 2K --quality high`.

evals.prompt: 画一张 iPhone 17 Pro 的产品图，要参考真实外观
evals.expected_output: Runs with --model nano-banana-2 --google-search when real-world product grounding is needed (secondary model, not a default).
